text.p: Zurich Insurance Group said it expected results in 1996 to be significantly better than last year.

"Unless faced with extraordinary events in the claims area, or in the financial or foreign exchange markets, Zurich Insurance Group anticipates an overall result in 1996 again significantly better than the year before," the group said in a statement.
However, it said the exceptionally strong profit rise achieved in the first half of 1996 did not directly reflect the increase expected in full-year 1996 profits.
Zurich Insurance also reported that its 1996 first half group net profit rose by 32.7 percent to 576.4 million Swiss francs.
The group reported a 1995 net profit of 874.1 million francs. -- Zuirich Editorial +41 1 631 7340
